title: 区分后训练中的能力激发与能力创造：自由能视角
summary: 本文从自由能视角出发，提出后训练应区分“能力激发”与“能力创造”。通过“可达支持集”概念，将SFT和RL视为对预训练分布的重加权，关键在于是否扩展模型的可达行为空间，而非训练方法本身。
summary_en: From a free-energy perspective, this paper distinguishes capability elicitation from capability creation in post-training. It introduces 'accessible support' to argue that SFT and RL reweight the pretrained distribution; the key is whether the reachable behavioral space expands.
